overview: RD-MLDG leverages class-relevant reasoning chains and multimodal LLMs for domain generalization, utilizing Multi-Task Cross-Training (MTCT) to guide reasoning optimization and Self-Aligned Reasoning Regularization (SARR) to mitigate reasoning pattern mismatches.

modules.name: DomainBed-Reasoning Construction Pipeline
modules.description: Implements the automated pipeline for generating class-relevant reasoning chains using a commercial MLLM. It handles the structured prompting for five sections (Summary, Caption, Reasoning, Reflection, Conclusion) and includes the rejection sampling logic to filter out incomplete or inconsistent generations, ensuring high-quality supervision data.

modules.name: Dual-Pathway Prompt Engineering
modules.description: Constructs the input prompts for the two distinct forward pathways used in training: the classification prompt (q_cls) for direct label prediction without thinking, and the reasoning prompt (q_reason) paired with the structured reasoning chain. It formats the candidate labels and question instructions appropriately for the target MLLM.

modules.name: DG Dataset & Domain-Aware DataLoader
modules.description: Manages the loading of DomainBed-Reasoning data, including image loading, label pairing, and reasoning chain retrieval. It implements the domain-aware splitting logic for leave-one-domain-out evaluation and handles the batching strategy required for multi-task training (concurrent handling of images, labels, and tokenized reasoning sequences).

modules.name: Base MLLM & Dual-LoRA Adapter Setup
modules.description: Initializes the base Multimodal Large Language Model (e.g., InternVL, LLaVA) and inserts LoRA adapters into both the vision encoder and the language decoder for parameter-efficient fine-tuning. It ensures the model architecture supports both visual feature extraction and text generation required by the dual pathways.

modules.name: Multi-Task Cross-Training (MTCT) Loss
modules.description: Calculates the joint loss function for MTCT. It combines the standard cross-entropy classification loss from the direct prediction pathway (q_cls) and the auto-regressive generation loss from the reasoning pathway (q_reason). It includes the length normalization logic for the reasoning chain loss to prevent long sequences from dominating the gradients.

modules.name: MTCT Training Engine
modules.description: Orchestrates the first stage of the training process. It executes the forward passes for both pathways, computes the MTCT loss, handles gradient accumulation and backpropagation, and manages the optimizer steps. It also logs the classification accuracy and reasoning generation metrics during training.

modules.name: SARR Self-Labeling & Filtering Engine
modules.description: Implements the inference and filtering logic for Self-Aligned Reasoning Regularization. It runs the current model in inference mode on the source domain data using the reasoning prompt, extracts the predicted conclusion from specific tags, compares it against the ground-truth label, and retains only the reasoning chains that yield correct conclusions for the next training round.

modules.name: SARR Iterative Training Loop
modules.description: Controls the outer loop for SARR, iterating over a specified number of self-labeling rounds. In each round, it triggers the self-labeling engine, updates the training dataset with the filtered self-generated reasoning chains (replacing the GPT-4o chains), and re-executes the MTCT training engine on the refined dataset.

modules.name: DomainBed Evaluation Protocol
modules.description: Implements the standard DomainBed evaluation framework. It performs leave-one-domain-out cross-validation across the specified datasets (PACS, VLCS, OfficeHome, TerraInc), calculates the classification accuracy on unseen target domains, and aggregates the results over multiple random seeds to ensure statistical robustness.

modules.name: Optimization Gap Analysis Toolkit
modules.description: Provides analysis tools to study Challenge 1 (Optimization Gap). It extracts and compares token probability distributions (for CLS tokens and all tokens) and training dynamics (loss curves, confidence thresholds) between direct label supervision and reasoning-chain supervision under both zero-shot and fine-tuned settings.

modules.name: Reasoning Pattern Mismatch Analysis
modules.description: Provides analysis tools to study Challenge 2 (Pattern Mismatch). It calculates token entropy reduction during optimization, identifies top-k tokens with the largest optimization gains, and compares the semantic characteristics and domain specificity of supervision signals from external models versus self-generated reasoning.

modules.name: Experiment Configuration & Tracking
modules.description: Manages the experiment lifecycle, including the parsing of YAML/JSON configurations for model size, LoRA rank, learning rate, and SARR rounds. It handles the seeding for reproducibility, checkpoint saving/loading for different MTCT and SARR stages, and the logging of metrics to experiment tracking dashboards.
